verdict.headline: M1-M18 is workflow-closed and visually conditional. Strong engineering backbone. No production-promoted terrain.
verdict.next_M_first_target: Replace the M18 smooth tan/sand procedural neighbor with a real-data-guided procedural terrain that has material identity and close-range detail.
verdict.orchestration_arc: Promote O1-O3 alongside M19; keep O4-O10 deferred unless they directly unblock M19-M24.

milestones.name: Material catalog / provenance / validation
milestones.notes: Catalog schema, provenance, and validation labels are honest. Visual labels are diagnostic-only at this layer.

milestones.name: Transition strip workflow + rules
milestones.notes: Strip generation and rules are reproducible. Treat early strip visuals as workflow proof, not art.
blockers: Standalone strip visuals are not gameplay-band evidence.

milestones.name: Chunk-size decision (256 m)
milestones.notes: 256 m base chunk is justified by sweep + budget evidence. Diagnostic visuals only.

milestones.name: Unified splat / source shader path
milestones.notes: Five-slot shader handles height/slope fallback, RGBA splat, source macro/detail. Source-stack rerenders carry visuals.
blockers: Early stand-alone shader screenshots are diagnostics, not visual passes.

milestones.name: Streamed walk through ChunkLoader
milestones.notes: Streamed walk works; collision + cache evidence exists. Close-band requires source-stack rerender to read.

milestones.name: Runtime hardening + finite-source policy
milestones.notes: Runtime caches, mirrored/wrap sampling policy, and source-noise audit are in place. Organic noise is real and tracked.
blockers: Source-material noise is real on green/organic classes; M8 owns remediation.

milestones.name: Rule-driven runtime transition masks
milestones.notes: Same-source mask QA is measurable and passes. Cross-material stress remains workflow conditional.

milestones.name: Organic source-material cleanup lane
milestones.notes: Regeneration queue is functioning. m8_grassland_grass_calm_v3 is a sidecar candidate; multiple organic classes are still blocked.
blockers: Organic textures still slightly pale/hazy under detail stress.
FLUX 2 / Aura / SD 3.5 bakeoff (m14_texture_bakeoff_plan.json) is staged but not yet selected.

milestones.name: Runtime polish / perf path
milestones.notes: M18 smoke: avg 4.72 ms / p95 7.98 ms / max 11.85 ms @ 1600x1000. Clean for a workflow scene but a single sample, not a streamed-area sweep.
blockers: No dedicated multi-area perf pass; treat current numbers as smoke only.

milestones.name: Seam/ecotone integration
milestones.notes: Same-source, real-to-real, real-to-procedural, and ecotone-layer workflows accepted. First muted-strip unlike-biome attempt is negative_evidence, rebuilt as ecotone-layer.
blockers: Ecotone scatter uses composite low-poly review meshes.
Real-to-procedural close-range PBR/detail still weak.

milestones.name: Junction/corner case library
milestones.notes: Three-way and four-way representative cases accepted workflow. Scatter still placeholder. T/L/island variants future work.
blockers: T/L/island junction variants still unbuilt.
Scatter assets are placeholder review meshes.

milestones.name: View-mode parity (close/medium/iso/topdown)
milestones.notes: Same contract inspectable across four bands; runtime parity proof accepted. Strongest workflow evidence in the project.
blockers: Not production art; workflow proof only.

milestones.name: Production promotion gate
milestones.notes: Gate is active and necessary. Candidates: 8 (3 workflow_ready_not_production, 5 conditional). Production-promoted count: 0.

milestones.name: Close-play material bakeoff / quality board
milestones.notes: Quality board and bakeoff lanes work. FLUX 2 9B + dev bakeoff staged 2026-05-10 but no winner selected; current sidecars not yet production-grade.
blockers: No FLUX 2 bakeoff winner selected yet.
m8_grassland_grass_calm_v3 sidecar still slightly pale/hazy at close detail stress.

milestones.name: Feature/scatter mask workflow
milestones.notes: Mask-driven scatter wired into runtime review. Density semantics documented.
blockers: All scatter primitives are procedural review meshes (rock/grass/decal), not authored assets.
Authored asset import path is the unblocker, not the mask workflow.

milestones.name: Source-stack gallery + iso sidecar
milestones.notes: Bulk gallery board reviewable. Cached iso impostor remains a renderer sidecar seed, not chunked runtime impostors. Iso band conditional because the sidecar is a single cached card.
blockers: Cached iso card is sidecar only; needs depth/picking/streaming before tactical use.

milestones.name: Real-data-guided procedural extraction
milestones.notes: Extraction board produces a compatible neighbor bundle. Proves the path, not procedural quality.
blockers: Procedural neighbor visual quality is the open M19 problem.

milestones.name: Representative runtime slice + closure harness
milestones.notes: Workflow-closed, visually conditional. Real-source side carries; procedural tan/sand side triggers the broad-smooth-tan visual veto on its own and is the project's biggest visible weakness. M11 junction ownership lives in the closure harness, not in the streamed terrain.
blockers: Procedural sand/tan side is too smooth and broad for AAA close play.
Scatter primitives are not authored assets.
Closure harness is a sidecar grid, not a single streamed composition.
Performance figure is a smoke sample, not a streamed-area sweep.

visual_vetos_observed.veto: broad smooth tan/sand field standing in for real material identity
visual_vetos_observed.consequence: Prevents M18 visual_pass on close/medium/topdown; drives M19 first target.

promotion_gate_findings.gate_assessment: Active and necessary. Every M14-M18 artifact either has a candidate entry or is explicitly outside the gate (M17 extraction, M16 gallery board). All four bands present for every workflow_ready_not_production item.

roadmap_decisions.m19_first_target: Replace the smooth tan/sand procedural neighbor with material-identity-bearing close-range procedural terrain.
roadmap_decisions.orchestration_arc: Promote O1-O3 as near-term operability work alongside M19.
